scope: Guarded app-only installation, flash device-checksum verification, and serial boot-health evidence for units A and B. Multiplayer runtime and gameplay acceptance are separate and remain pending in this record.
selected_scope:
0.65 Tab5 app-only successor to the checksum-verified 0.64 installations on backed-up units A/ST7121 and B/ST7123. Preserve bootloader, partition table, OTA selector, NVS, microSD contents, exact protected-game package lineage, SDK and component locks. Existing explicit user authorization covers fixes, remote debug controls, flashing both units and multiplayer gameplay testing.

Candidate scope: original-roster Doom Arena guest leave/rejoin with a bounded PSRAM command journal, retained RTC resume identity, explicit authenticated resume handshake and deterministic cold-engine replay; host continues while the guest is absent. First-ever guest joining a solo running host is staged separately and is not claimed in this candidate. Restore the playfield/border beneath score, break and voting overlays; keep SCORE/Start as the explicit score control. Optimize touch overlay spans/blending, packed palette expansion, XRGB-to-RGB565 conversion and exact Tab5 5-to-6 prescaling without changing pixel results or viewport geometry. Add separate prescale/PPA and complete network-poll timing counters to existing bounded periodic telemetry. Admit immutable existing-scanout screenshots during Doom and native cartridge play with transfer cancellation on runtime transitions; report exact native package identity. Enable existing bounded SMF0/1 MIDI synthesis behind the ref-counted Doom music API while preserving MUS playback, through the existing audio worker. Update visible OS version and corresponding legacy fixtures to 0.65.

This scope documents candidate behavior, not physical acceptance. Require final focused host tests, pinned normal Tab5 firmware build, drift-bound source snapshot and exact-image guarded app-only flashing, followed by two-unit repeated guest leave/rejoin, overlay screenshots and sustained gameplay measurements with music and sound effects. Latest user cadence floor is at least 25 FPS, with 30 FPS retained as the optimization target. Record failures and audio evidence accurately; backend signal counters do not prove speaker audibility.
MIDI parser tempo guard is formatted unambiguously for the pinned target compiler; behavior is unchanged.
